name: Grain
description: Grain public API reads and manages meeting recordings, highlights and uploads, with webhooks and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal and Workspace Access Tokens are sent as Authorization Bearer tokens; OAuth2 is required for integrations distributed to other Grain users.
gate_detail: Personal access tokens are available on every plan including Free. Workspace tokens for server-side workspace-wide access need an admin on Business or Enterprise. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Read and manage recordings, highlights, tags and sharing, upload external recordings, download video and transcripts in several formats, and receive webhooks when recordings are processed.
mcp_notes: Official Grain MCP server connects Claude and ChatGPT to meeting data using OAuth, or a personal access token for developers; URL not shown.
blocker_detail: Workspace-wide access requires an admin on a Business or Enterprise plan, but personal tokens and OAuth2 are self-serve.
